queen-of-tears.title: Queen of Tears
queen-of-tears.tagline: A chaebol marriage on the edge, and a love worth saving
queen-of-tears.synopsis: Hong Hae-in is the third-generation heiress of the Queens Group. Her husband, Baek Hyun-woo, is the group's legal director and a farmers' son from the village of Yongdu-ri. Three years in, their marriage is close to divorce, until sudden news forces the two of them to face each other again.
whyWatch: Kim Soo-hyun and Kim Ji-won as a married couple who make you laugh and cry in the same scene
Big-family comedy between a rich clan and a warm country village
Seoul spots from the show you can visit, like The Hyundai Seoul and Cheonggye Plaza

lovely-runner.title: Lovely Runner
lovely-runner.tagline: A fan travels back in time to save her favorite star
lovely-runner.synopsis: Im Sol has long found the will to keep going in the songs of Ryu Sun-jae, lead singer of the band Eclipse. When news of his sudden death breaks her heart, she is sent back to 2008, to the summer they were both 19, and decides to change his fate.
whyWatch: Byeon Woo-seok's star-making turn as swimmer-turned-idol Ryu Sun-jae
A time-slip romance that jumps between the present and the late 2000s
A soundtrack built around the in-story band Eclipse

when-life-gives-you-tangerines.title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
when-life-gives-you-tangerines.tagline: A Jeju love story told across the four seasons of a life
when-life-gives-you-tangerines.synopsis: On 1950s Jeju Island, outspoken Oh Ae-sun dreams of becoming a poet, while quiet, steady Yang Gwan-sik has eyes only for her. Told like the four seasons, the story follows the island girl and boy from childhood into the joys and hardships of growing up.
whyWatch: IU and Park Bo-gum lead, with Moon So-ri and Park Hae-joon as their older selves
A family saga about mothers, daughters and the haenyeo divers of Jeju
Shot across Jeju, from Seongsan Ilchulbong to Hallim Port

king-the-land.title: King the Land
king-the-land.tagline: An heir who hates fake smiles meets a hotel's brightest one
king-the-land.synopsis: Gu Won is the heir of the King Group, a luxury hotel giant, and he cannot stand fake smiles. Cheon Sa-rang is a hotelier at King Hotel who always wears one. Their first meeting goes badly, and it is only the start of a workplace romance in the middle of a family succession fight.
whyWatch: Lee Jun-ho of 2PM and Lim Yoona of Girls' Generation as the lead couple
Glossy hotel, airline and travel settings for an easy feel-good watch
The hotel lobby scenes were shot at Parnas Hotel Jeju

my-demon.title: My Demon
my-demon.tagline: A ruthless heiress and a powerless demon make a deal
my-demon.synopsis: Do Do-hee is a sharp, guarded heiress with no shortage of enemies. Jeong Gu-won is a demon who trades favors for human souls. When he suddenly loses his powers and a strange mark appears on her wrist, the two agree to an unlikely contract to keep each other safe.
whyWatch: Song Kang as a stylish, sharp-tongued demon
A contract-marriage romance with a fantasy twist
Kim You-jung's fierce and funny heiress

marry-my-husband.title: Marry My Husband
marry-my-husband.tagline: Betrayed and sent back ten years, she rewrites her fate
marry-my-husband.synopsis: Kang Ji-won, a kind office worker battling cancer, discovers that her husband and her best friend have betrayed her. After a tragic night, she wakes up ten years in the past and sets out to change her future, with her team leader Yoo Ji-hyuk at her side.
whyWatch: A revenge story with a time-slip setup and very satisfying payoffs
Park Min-young and Na In-woo's slow-burn office romance
Based on a popular web novel and webtoon, with scenes at Seoul's Cheonggye Plaza

doctor-slump.title: Doctor Slump
doctor-slump.tagline: Two burnt-out doctors and old rivals find their way back
doctor-slump.synopsis: In high school, Yeo Jeong-woo and Nam Ha-neul fought for the top spot in every exam. Years later, he is a star plastic surgeon and she is an overworked anesthesiology resident, and both hit rock bottom at the same time. Fate makes them neighbors again.
whyWatch: Park Hyung-sik and Park Shin-hye as rivals turned allies
A gentle, honest look at burnout and starting over
Rom-com banter with a healing heart

love-next-door.title: Love Next Door
love-next-door.tagline: Your mom's friend's son knows all your secrets
love-next-door.synopsis: Bae Seok-ryu had a picture-perfect life abroad: a dream job and an engagement. Then she suddenly comes home to Korea. Back in her old neighborhood she runs into Choi Seung-hyo, a top architect, her mom's best friend's son and the keeper of her childhood memories.
whyWatch: Jung Hae-in and Jung So-min's childhood-friends chemistry
A cozy neighborhood full of nosy, lovable parents
A warm story about quitting, resting and starting again

when-the-phone-rings.title: When the Phone Rings
when-the-phone-rings.tagline: A cold arranged marriage and a call that changes it
when-the-phone-rings.synopsis: Presidential spokesperson Baek Sa-eon and sign language interpreter Hong Hee-joo have kept up a picture-perfect marriage for three years while barely speaking to each other. Then a threatening call from a kidnapper turns their quiet arrangement upside down.
whyWatch: A romance and thriller in one, with a mystery to solve
Yoo Yeon-seok and Chae Soo-bin's tense, slow-burning chemistry
Sign language and silence play a key part in the story

bon-appetit-your-majesty.title: Bon Appétit, Your Majesty
bon-appetit-your-majesty.tagline: A modern chef ends up cooking for a Joseon king
bon-appetit-your-majesty.synopsis: Chef Yeon Ji-yeong has just won a top prize in Paris. On her flight home to Seoul, a solar eclipse sends her back to the Joseon era, straight into the court of King Lee Heon. To survive the palace, she has to win over a king with a demanding palate, one dish at a time.
whyWatch: Lim Yoona as a confident chef in a Joseon palace kitchen
Mouthwatering cooking scenes that mix modern technique with old ingredients
Lee Chae-min as a young king who slowly lets his guard down

our-unwritten-seoul.title: Our Unwritten Seoul
our-unwritten-seoul.tagline: Twin sisters secretly swap lives between Seoul and home
our-unwritten-seoul.synopsis: Identical twins Yoo Mi-ji and Yoo Mi-rae could not be more different. Mi-ji, a former sprinter, stays in their small hometown caring for their grandmother, while Mi-rae works at a public corporation in Seoul. When Mi-rae starts to struggle, Mi-ji suggests they trade places.
whyWatch: Park Bo-young plays both twins
A tender story about work, family and finding your own pace
Seoul spots from the show, like Seongsu and Ikseon-dong's hanok street

resident-playbook.title: Resident Playbook
resident-playbook.tagline: First-year OB-GYN residents learn hospital life
resident-playbook.synopsis: At the Jongno branch of Yulje Medical Center, a group of first-year residents choose obstetrics and gynecology, a department few want in an era of low birth rates. Oh Yi-young and her new colleagues face long shifts, tough seniors and the first patients they will never forget.
whyWatch: Set in the same world as Hospital Playlist
Go Youn-jung leads a fresh group of young doctors
Friendship, humor and a realistic look at medical training

can-this-love-be-translated.title: Can This Love Be Translated?
can-this-love-be-translated.tagline: An interpreter, a global star and love lost in translation
can-this-love-be-translated.synopsis: Joo Ho-jin is a multilingual interpreter who lives by logic. Cha Mu-hee is an actress who became a global star after a hit zombie film. When he takes a job interpreting for a dating show she stars in, filmed overseas, two people who speak very different languages of love end up side by side.
whyWatch: From the Hong sisters, the writers of Hotel del Luna
Kim Seon-ho and Go Youn-jung as an odd-couple pair
Filmed in Korea, Japan, Canada and Italy

crash-landing-on-you.title: Crash Landing on You
crash-landing-on-you.tagline: A paragliding accident lands an heiress in North Korea
crash-landing-on-you.synopsis: Yoon Se-ri, a South Korean heiress and fashion CEO, is swept off course in a paragliding accident and lands on the North Korean side of the border. There she meets Ri Jeong-hyeok, a stern army captain who decides to hide her while she looks for a way home.
whyWatch: Hyun Bin and Son Ye-jin's much-loved chemistry
Funny, heartfelt friendships with the soldiers of Company Five
A Jeju filming spot to visit: the Ara-dong historic trail

goblin.title: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God
goblin.tagline: An immortal goblin, his bride and a grim reaper roommate
goblin.synopsis: Also known as Goblin. For more than 900 years, Kim Shin, a general from the Goryeo era, has lived as an immortal goblin, waiting for the bride who can end his curse. Then he meets Ji Eun-tak, a cheerful high school student who can see ghosts and says she is that bride.
whyWatch: Gong Yoo and Lee Dong-wook's housemate comedy
A fantasy romance with a beloved soundtrack
Seoul spots to walk, like Unhyeongung and Gamgodang-gil

itaewon-class.title: Itaewon Class
itaewon-class.tagline: A small pub in Itaewon and a long game of payback
itaewon-class.synopsis: After a life-changing clash with the heir of the food company Jangga Group, Park Sae-ro-yi loses almost everything. Years later he opens a small pub called DanBam in Seoul's Itaewon, with a long plan to take Jangga down, joined by Jo Yi-seo, a sharp young influencer.
whyWatch: Park Seo-joon as a stubborn underdog founder
Based on the webtoon of the same name
Itaewon filming spots, like the Noksapyeong overpass

hotel-del-luna.title: Hotel del Luna
hotel-del-luna.tagline: A hotel in the heart of Seoul where only ghosts check in
hotel-del-luna.synopsis: Hidden in downtown Seoul, Hotel del Luna welcomes only ghosts. Its owner, the glamorous and sharp-tongued Jang Man-wol, has been bound to it for over a thousand years. When elite hotelier Gu Chan-sung is pulled in as the new manager, the worlds of the living and the dead begin to mix.
whyWatch: IU's glamorous, unforgettable Jang Man-wol
A new ghost story in almost every episode
From the Hong sisters, with Seoul spots like Hyemindang

extraordinary-attorney-woo.title: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
extraordinary-attorney-woo.tagline: A brilliant rookie lawyer who sees the world differently
extraordinary-attorney-woo.synopsis: Woo Young-woo graduated top of her law school class, remembers everything she reads and loves whales more than anything. As a rookie attorney with autism at the large law firm Hanbada, she takes on case after case and wins over her colleagues with her own way of thinking.
whyWatch: Park Eun-bin's award-winning lead performance
A new legal case almost every episode, easy to dip into
Filming spots in Jeju and Seoul's Ikseon-dong

business-proposal.title: Business Proposal
business-proposal.tagline: A fake blind date with her own CEO goes very wrong
business-proposal.synopsis: To help a rich friend escape an arranged blind date, office worker Shin Ha-ri goes in her place, planning to get rejected fast. The plan backfires when the man across the table turns out to be Kang Tae-moo, the CEO of her own company, who decides to marry her.
whyWatch: Based on a hit webtoon, and just 12 episodes
Ahn Hyo-seop and Kim Se-jeong's laugh-out-loud chemistry
A fun second couple: Kim Min-kyu and Seol In-ah

twenty-five-twenty-one.title: Twenty-Five Twenty-One
twenty-five-twenty-one.tagline: A fencer, a dreamer and the youth they shared in 1998
twenty-five-twenty-one.synopsis: In 1998, as a financial crisis shakes Korea, high school fencer Na Hee-do refuses to give up after her school team is cut. Baek Yi-jin, whose family lost everything, is trying to start over. Their paths cross, and a friendship begins that will shape their youth.
whyWatch: Kim Tae-ri's bright, unstoppable Na Hee-do
Nostalgic late-1990s Korea, told through an old diary
A story about friendship and growing up as much as romance

true-beauty.title: True Beauty
true-beauty.tagline: Makeup, a new school and the boy who knows her secret
true-beauty.synopsis: After years of being teased about her looks, Lim Ju-kyung learns makeup from online tutorials and transfers to a new school as its new 'goddess'. Keeping her bare face a secret is hard enough, until Lee Su-ho, the school's cool star, becomes the one person who knows it.
whyWatch: Based on the hit webtoon by Yaongyi
Cha Eun-woo of ASTRO and Hwang In-youp in a love triangle
A light high school rom-com about self-confidence

our-beloved-summer.title: Our Beloved Summer
our-beloved-summer.tagline: Exes forced back in front of the camera years later
our-beloved-summer.synopsis: In high school, top student Kook Yeon-soo and last-place Choi Ung were filmed for a documentary that went viral. Years after their breakup, the old footage resurfaces and the cameras return, forcing the two exes to face each other and the summer they never finished.
whyWatch: Choi Woo-shik and Kim Da-mi, reunited after the film The Witch
A soft, documentary-style love story
Seoul's Gamgodang-gil appears in the show

reply-1988.title: Reply 1988
reply-1988.tagline: Five families, one alley and the warmest year in Seoul
reply-1988.synopsis: In 1988, five families share a small alley in Seoul's Ssangmun-dong. Sung Deok-sun, a cheerful middle child, spends her days with childhood friends Jung-hwan, Sun-woo, Dong-ryong and Go prodigy Choi Taek, while their parents trade side dishes, worries and laughs.
whyWatch: An ensemble family comedy that feels like home
Nostalgic late-1980s Seoul, from music to fashion
Park Bo-gum, Lee Hye-ri and Ryu Jun-yeol in breakout roles

start-up.title: Start-Up
start-up.tagline: Young founders chase big dreams in Korea's startup scene
start-up.synopsis: Seo Dal-mi dreams of becoming Korea's Steve Jobs. Nam Do-san is a math whiz whose company, Samsan Tech, is going nowhere. A teenage pen-pal secret and a startup hub called Sandbox bring them together, while sharp investor Han Ji-pyeong watches closely.
whyWatch: Bae Suzy, Nam Joo-hyuk and Kim Seon-ho in a love triangle
An upbeat look at founders, investors and failing forward
Seoul spots like Oil Tank Culture Park and Nodeul Island
